reason: I'd use the free first collab since the café asked, but I'm not paying to make promo videos for businesses that aren't paying me. I have a rate card and brands already come to me or my manager, so ₹499 isn't the issue; giving away content is.
objection: As a pass holder I have to make short promotional videos for participating businesses. That's unpaid work, and it cheapens my rates. And most local cafés on a platform like this will want to pay in food, not money.
would_change_my_mind: If the promo videos were optional, or paid at my rate, and Mitra showed me real paid briefs from brands that pay what my rate card says.
